answer.text: Insert the key in the pillion seat key slot and turn it clockwise.
Slide the pillion seat forward to remove it.
Slide the rider seat backward to remove it.
To refit, slide the rider seat forward so it lines up with the frame.
Place the pillion seat and slide it backward.
Make sure the pillion seat lines up with the frame, then press the seat to lock it with the key in position.
